query_model.description: Run an open model from Hugging Face on your text: summarise, classify, translate or embed it, depending on the model.

mock_response.generated_text: Hugging Face builds tools for machine learning and hosts open models.

result.summary_text: Hugging Face builds tools for machine learning and hosts open models.

query_model.name: query_model

parameters.description: The model's name as it appears at the top of its page on huggingface.co, such as `facebook/bart-large-cnn`. Pick a model whose page lists HF Inference under 'Inference Providers', as only those can be run from here.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The text to give the model: a passage to summarise or translate, a sentence to classify, a prompt to continue, and so on.
parameters.name: inputs

parameters.description: Optional settings for the model, such as {"max_length": 130, "min_length": 30} to set a summary's length. The model's page lists what it takes. Leave empty for its defaults.
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.description: A model that hasn't been used for a while takes a moment to start. Leave on to wait for it rather than fail.
parameters.display_name: Wait for the model to start
parameters.name: wait_for_model

query_model.result_str_template: Received a response from the model.

generated_text.description: The model's primary text output, for text-producing tasks (summarization, translation, generation). Null for tasks that don't produce text (see 'result').

model.description: The name of the model that was run.

result.description: The raw model output. Its shape depends on the model's task: a list of summaries for summarization, nested label/score lists for classification, and so on.

description: Run open models from Hugging Face on your text.
